actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: RNA shows strong adjusted-significant down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty-acid metabolism (NES -1.86 to -2.49, FDR q 0.001), and WXS shows globally adjusted-significant PBRM1 enrichment (14/14 vs 25/89, OR 73.35, q_global 7.85e-04) with driver-panel VHL enrichment. No candidate-specific technical factor is supported (all q>=0.447). Membership is conflicting (WXS strongly positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the pair boundaries to the nearest neighbors are not merge-supporting: K7_C0001-K7_C0004 boundary representation is weak/conflicting and its structural screen shows a represented boundary (ARI 0.758) with a single-cluster-dominated union, and K7_C0001-K7_C0007 shows a conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union. No supported split or merge rescue is available, so the candidate remains a defensible independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant immune/inflammatory down-regulation with oxidative-phosphorylation up-regulation (NES -2.06 to -2.85 and +1.74 to +2.52, FDR q 0.001-0.005), and WXS shows globally adjusted-significant VHL depletion (0/16 vs 56/87, OR 0.017, q_global 0.0024) with consistent PBRM1 depletion. No candidate-specific technical factor is supported (all q>=0.535). Membership representation is coherently negative across all four geometries, but the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0002-K7_C0003 shows weak but consistently positive representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union; K7_C0002-K7_C0004 shows weak positive representation with a largely reproduced boundary (ARI 0.772); and K7_C0002-K7_C0005 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K7_C0003 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant up-regulation of interferon/TNFA/NFKB/allograft-rejection immune programs (NES +2.50 to +3.52, FDR q 0.001) with coordinated EMT/myogenesis down-regulation. WXS shows no adjusted-significant mutation signal, but RNA provides a substantive interpretable phenotype. Candidate-specific technical associations are supported (tissue source site V=0.529, CT manufacturer V=0.366, scanner model V=0.472, kernel V=0.392, slice thickness eps2=0.245, z-spacing eps2=0.249), which weighs against terminal acceptance; however, the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0002-K7_C0003 shows weak but consistently positive representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union; K7_C0003-K7_C0005 shows coherent weak-to-modest positive representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure; and K7_C0003-K7_C0007 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K7_C0004 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant down-regulation of immune/interferon, complement, EMT, and inflammatory programs (NES -1.72 to -2.13, FDR q 0.001) with proliferation down-regulation and TGF-beta up-regulation (NES +1.83, FDR q 0.002). WXS shows no adjusted-significant mutation signal, but RNA provides a substantive interpretable phenotype. Candidate-specific technical associations are supported (CT phase V=0.349, CT manufacturer V=0.222, slice thickness eps2=0.090, z-spacing eps2=0.069), which weighs against terminal acceptance; however, the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0004-K7_C0006 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with a largely reproduced boundary (ARI 0.871) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure; K7_C0004-K7_C0007 shows coherent weak-to-modest positive representation with only a partially reproduced boundary (ARI 0.630) and a single-cluster-dominated union; and K7_C0001-K7_C0004 shows weak/conflicting representation with a represented boundary (ARI 0.758) and a single-cluster-dominated union. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K7_C0005 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant up-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs (NES +1.85 to +2.83, FDR q 0.001) with UV-response-DN/androgen-response down-regulation, and WXS shows globally adjusted-significant BAP1 enrichment (10/18 vs 3/85, OR 34.17, q_global 1.49e-03). Candidate-specific technical associations are supported (tissue source site V=0.398, z-spacing eps2=0.058), which weighs against terminal acceptance; however, the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0005-K7_C0006 shows weak/partially conflicting representation but the strongest graph separation (ARI 1.0, within 0.533 vs between 0.080, normalized cut 0.268) with a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure; K7_C0002-K7_C0005 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure; and K7_C0003-K7_C0005 shows coherent weak-to-modest positive representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K7_C0006 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant up-regulation of EMT and UV-response-DN programs (NES +2.27 to +2.53, FDR q 0.001) with oxidative-phosphorylation/MYC/ROS/DNA-repair down-regulation, and WXS shows driver-panel-significant VHL enrichment (13/13 vs 43/90, OR 29.48, q_driver 2.85e-03) with PBRM1 depletion (q_driver 0.0118). No candidate-specific technical factor is supported (all q>=0.540). Membership is conflicting (WXS strongly positive, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0005-K7_C0006 shows weak/partially conflicting representation but the strongest graph separation (ARI 1.0, normalized cut 0.268) with a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure, and K7_C0004-K7_C0006 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with a largely reproduced boundary (ARI 0.871) and a two-cluster union aligned with the current structure. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K7_C0007 has a coherent biological identity: RNA shows adjusted-significant up-regulation of cell-cycle/proliferation programs (NES +1.65 to +2.78, FDR q 0.001-0.006) with immune/interferon down-regulation. WXS shows only directionally coherent but statistically fragile signals (PBRM1 4/4 vs 35/99, nominal p=0.019; VHL depletion) that do not survive multiplicity adjustment, and the set has only 4 members. No candidate-specific technical factor is supported (all q>=0.333). Membership is conflicting (WXS maximal, CT/RNA/WSI negative), but the relevant pair boundaries are not merge-supporting: K7_C0004-K7_C0007 shows coherent weak-to-modest positive representation with only a partially reproduced boundary (ARI 0.630) and a single-cluster-dominated union; K7_C0003-K7_C0007 shows weak/partially conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union; and K7_C0001-K7_C0007 shows conflicting representation with an exactly reproduced boundary (ARI 1.0) and a single-cluster-dominated union. No supported split or merge rescue is available.
